summary: community.docker deprecates EOL ansible-core versions. Its next major drops 2.11 to 2.14.
questions: Which ansible-core versions will community.docker stop supporting?

answer_card.title: community.docker EOL core deprecation
answer_card.answer_md: The next major community.docker release drops ansible-core 2.11, 2.12, 2.13 and 2.14.
